applicable_to: Restaurants (51% of total sales from ready-to-eat food for immediate consumption)
required_topics: Definition of human trafficking and commercial exploitation of children
Identification of individuals most at risk for human trafficking
Differences between human trafficking for labor and sex within the context of lodging establishments, restaurants, and truck stops
Employees' roles in reporting and responding to instances of human trafficking
risks_or_constraints: Potential fines of up to $1,500 per offense if not corrected within 30 days
